_comment: Round-trip cost model for NSE equity intraday (MIS) at Dhan. Rates as fractions of traded value. Checked 2026-11-01 against the source pages below; re-check before relying on them, rates change.

sources.dhan_pricing: https://dhan.co/pricing/ (Equity Intraday: Rs 20 or 0.03% per executed order, whichever is lower; STT 0.025% on sell; NSE transaction 0.0030699%; SEBI 0.0001%; stamp 0.003% on buy; IPFT 0.0000001%; GST 18% on brokerage + transaction + SEBI + IPFT)
sources.slippage: assumption from the brief: 0.03% of price per side, not a measured figure
